description: Everything the oracle replaces. Only the GPU, the clock, transports and external services may be replaced; check_mocks.py fails if an entry names decision code.

mocks.how: constructed by the harness instead of by a model runner: each scheduled request that reaches the end of its known tokens samples its next assigned output token from the scenario
vLLM's own CPU test helper builds the real Scheduler with a fixed KV capacity (num_blocks) and a 1-head, 1-dim float32 full-attention spec, so no tensors are allocated; it is called, not modified

the assigned output's last token is sampled as EOS_TOKEN_ID (tests/v1/core/utils.py:43), so the simulator's output-length input ends the request through vLLM's own check_stop; max_tokens carries only a client budget
